replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
lol.

YML is the coding format for most Avicus minigames. It controls spawn points, inventory, monuments, etc. If you don't know how to code it, you could ask a mapdev or something to do it for you (or if you know anyone else who'd be willing to sacrifice their time). 

The download is relatively simple. Go into %appdata%, find you Minecraft.jar file, open it, look inside for "saves", open that, find the singleplayer world and drag it onto your desktop or somewhere you won't forget. Go to Mediafire (or whatever you wish to use) and make a download for the map. If it's on a multiplayer world, ask the owner to retrieve the file. (I think this is right).

To archive your post, click edit on your original post, scroll down and directly above that "Post" button or whatever there should be a box. Next to it it says "archive". Check it off and hit "Update post".

Phew.
